naming_patterns.pattern: Command classes use Generate*Command naming and flexible_graphql:* command names.
Service IDs and tags use the flexible_graphql.* prefix.
Configuration root is flexible_graphql and consumer-facing sample config is YAML.

feature_structure_patterns.pattern: Feature additions usually require coordinated changes across Configuration.php, FlexibleGraphqlExtension.php, sample YAML, and docs.
Generation features are wired via DI and executed either through cache warm or explicit console commands.

error_handling_patterns.pattern: CLI commands return Command::FAILURE when requested schema elements are missing and emit SymfonyStyle errors.
Default field resolution falls back to PropertyAccessor when GraphQL defaultFieldResolver returns null.

formatting_tooling_patterns.pattern: PHP files declare strict_types=1 except the Bundle class file.
No in-repo formatter, linter, or static-analysis config file is present; PHPStan is only mentioned in CHANGELOG.md.

dependency_usage_patterns.pattern: Bundle delegates schema parsing and code generation to axtiva/flexible-graphql-php builders instead of implementing its own generator logic.
Symfony PropertyAccess is used to implement a default GraphQL field resolver fallback.

testing_patterns.pattern: phpunit/phpunit is required in composer.json, but no test files or phpunit.xml are present in the repository snapshot.

configuration_patterns.pattern: schema_type gates federation-specific builder selection and representation wiring.
executor selects sync or async amphp type-registry builder implementations.
